headline: Backup Report for Collin County Homes
summary: Homes in Collin County face a moderate risk. A long outage of 12 hours or more happens about once every 11 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 34% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 54 hours. In May 2024, 23% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 45 hours. One Core lasts about 12 hours in August. One Core lasts about 24 hours in February. Two Cores last about 18 hours in August. Two Cores cover 81% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours for gas heat and a larger footprint homes. Base confirms sizing at install.
